text:
Leah: proposal: rework onboarding into three explicit lanes so we can optimize for speed, determinism, and quality separately. lanes: SMOKE, COMPAT, SHADOW. short rationale below.
Omar: curious what each lane asserts and timescales?
Leah: SMOKE (30-90s): start, sanity; ensure model loads, tokenizer roundtrip for 20 canonical tokens, no immediate OOM, KV layout present, and a tiny perf smoke (<150ms p50 on ci-tiny). COMPAT (5-20m): deterministic ABI, kernel selection parity, kv-cache mapping + memory growth profile, and tokenization edgecases across 50 seed prompts. SHADOW (hours/day): offline quality evals + shadow traffic replay for latency/cost/regression signals.
Kai: sounds good. how do we keep SMOKE fast but meaningful? small sampling often misses regressions.
Nina: make SMOKE assert strict runtime invariants only (OOM, segfaults, kernel fallbacks). Make COMPAT the one that gates rollout for default tenants. SHADOW is for product/ops to decide final go/no-go.
Omar: owners? will this add alert noise?
Leah: ownership: eng-ml owns SMOKE + COMPAT infra; product-ops owns SHADOW eval corpus and thresholds. Alerts: only COMPAT failures create paging alerts; SMOKE failures create intake tickets; SHADOW failures raise a ticket to product-ops but not pager.
Kai: what about cost? running COMPAT on every push will be expensive.
Leah: heuristic: run full COMPAT for major version bumps, new quantization modes, or if SMOKE detects kernel mismatches. Otherwise run COMPAT-delta (compare small strata against last vetted model) which uses cached embeddings and delta metrics.
Nina: we need a clear sampling strata for COMPAT-delta. I'll propose buckets: short(<=32), medium(33-128), long(129-1024), plus top-30 user prompts and tokenization edgecases. Target 100 stratified prompts.
Omar: console UX: I'd like statuses: SMOKE_PASS, COMPAT_PASS/FAIL, SHADOW_PENDING/FAIL/PASS and an overall onboarding_state. Teams can set rollout policies per-tenant: strict (block on COMPAT_FAIL), permissive (allow with warning).
Kai: for deterministic checks, capture a model fingerprint in intake: {model_version, arch, tokenizer_hash, quant_bits, export_tool, check_sum}. Use that to drive cache-compat and binary diffing.
Leah: example intake stanza: 
```
intake:
  model_version: v2.1.0
  arch: mosaic-7b
  tokenizer_hash: sha256:aaa111
  quant_bits: 4
  export_tool: export-v1.2
  datestamp: 2026-03-22
```
Nina: good. also log the kernel selection map so COMPAT can assert no unexpected fallback to emulation kernels.
Omar: what about rollbacks? if SHADOW shows quality regressions after rollout, we need automated rollback hooks.
Leah: yes: tie SHADOW monitors to rollout controller with an automated rollback threshold (e.g., deltas worse than X% for top-5 intent buckets for > 1h). Product-ops to define X.
Kai: action items?
Leah: 1) Leah+Omar: draft SMOKE/COMPAT assertion list + numeric thresholds, 2) Nina: sampling strata doc + golden corpus spec, 3) Kai: intake fingerprint schema + Console states mapping, 4) eng-sre: quota impact estimate (tagging). I'll open tickets.
onboard-bot: created ticket ONB-7034 "three-lane onboarding: COMPAT strata + smoke assertions" (assignee: Omar).
Omar: i'll start a short doc with thresholds and a PoC script for SMOKE that runs in CI container.
Nina: i'll enumerate the golden prompts and include seqlen/genre annotations.
Kai: i'll PR intake schema and Console state mapping.
Leah: thanks. thumbs if you agree so I can move this to RFC follow-up. :thumbsup:
Omar: +1
Kai: +1
Nina: +1
Leah: closing thread, will link ONB-7034 in the PRD.
